evals.prompt: I ran a model panel on a compound library and got this file: `/Users/mduranfrigola/Documents/GitHub/ersilia-skills/skills/molecule-auditing/assets/drugbank_head_example.csv`. I'm not sure what all the columns mean — help me make sense of it and pick which to keep.

assertions: The agent decodes raw column names like 'inhibition_50um.eos4e40' and 'ames.eos7m30' into plain-language meanings using fetched metadata (not guesses)
The agent presents a column inventory (column -> meaning -> direction) and asks the user which to keep and their roles
